title: Injectivity of complete-flag pullback with arbitrary support
statement:
Use [def-pur-conventions] at finite coefficients, the supported groups [def-pur-support-cohomology] and twists [def-coefficient-twists-detailed]. Let $r\geq0$ and let $F$ be a finite locally free module of constant rank $r$ [def-amb-finite-locally-free-module] on a separated finite-type $k$-scheme $T$, let $p:T'=\operatorname{Fl}_T(F)\to T$ be [def-pur-complete-flag-bundle], and let $Z\hookrightarrow T$ be any closed subscheme. For every degree $b$ and twist $a$, pullback is a split injection
$$p^*:H^b_Z(T,A(a))\longrightarrow H^b_{Z\times_TT'}(T',A(a)).$$
The splitting is induced by projection onto the degree-zero summand of the iterated decomposition of $Rp_*A_{T'}$ in [thm-pur-projective-bundle-formula], under the projection formula. No regularity or smoothness of $Z$ is assumed.

source.place: Step 1: the flag-bundle pullback is injective (arbitrary closed support)

proof.text:
For $r=0$ or $r=1$, [def-pur-complete-flag-bundle] makes $p$ the identity, so the identity splits every supported pullback. For $r\geq2$ the same recursive definition expresses $p$ as a finite tower
$$T'=T_s\xrightarrow{q_s}T_{s-1}\longrightarrow\cdots\xrightarrow{q_1}T_0=T,$$
where each $q_j$ is the projectivization of a locally free module of positive constant rank. The tautological kernel used for the next stage has rank one less. By [lem-pur-projective-bundle-tautological-geometry] each stage is proper and locally a projective-space bundle; the standard affine charts are polynomial affine spaces over affine base charts. Consequently the intermediate schemes remain separated and of finite type over $k$, as required for the projective-bundle formula. Put $Z_j=Z\times_TT_j$. It remains to construct the prescribed splitting for a single stage $q:P\to B$ and an arbitrary closed $C\hookrightarrow B$.

source.place: Step 1: degree-zero projective-bundle splitting with arbitrary closed support; explicit adjunction calculation

proof.text: We record the coefficient comparisons needed below, for all integers $a$. Choose $N$ with $\ell^NA=0$. Write $L^{\mathrm{et}}_S(a)$ for the etale Tate lines of [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback] with $m=\ell^N$. The statement of [lem-pur-kummer-additivity] specifies the projection-induced identification $\nu_S^*L^{\mathrm{et}}_S(1)\cong A_S(1)$ for every such killing exponent. Tensor powers give the same identification for $a>0$ by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback], and $a=0$ is the constant coefficient unit. For $a<0$, apply inverse image to the evaluation between a positive tensor power and its dual: on a cover where the positive line is free of rank one this is the multiplication pairing $A\otimes_A A\to A$, whose dual comparison is the identity. Hence it is an isomorphism and gives the prescribed negative twist. The etale lines are locally constant finite free lines by [lem-asd-etale-finite-twist-pullback], so their pro-etale realizations are bounded constructible complexes in degree zero. That node's functorial pullback isomorphisms, together with [lem-weil-pbc-comparison-pullback], identify $Lq^*A_B(a)$ with $A_P(a)$. In particular these coefficients satisfy both the etale-origin requirement of supported-Hom pullback and the constructibility requirement of the finite-ring projection formula. No freeness of $A$ over $\mathbf Z/\ell^N$ is used.

source.place: Step 1: degree-zero projective-bundle splitting with arbitrary closed support; explicit adjunction calculation

proof.text:
Suppose the bundle defining $q$ has rank $d+1$. By [thm-pur-projective-bundle-formula] there is an isomorphism
$$\Phi:\bigoplus_{e=0}^{d}A_B(-e)[-2e]\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*A_P.$$
Its $e=0$ component is the adjoint of the identity of $A_P$, since $h^0=1$. By the adjunction $Lq^*\dashv Rq_*$ of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], this component is the unit $\eta_{A_B}:A_B\to Rq_*A_P$. Define $r_0=\operatorname{pr}_0\Phi^{-1}$. The biproduct identity $\operatorname{pr}_0\operatorname{in}_0=1$ gives $r_0\eta_{A_B}=1$. Thus it is the actual adjunction unit, rather than an unspecified copy of $A_B$, that the degree-zero projection retracts.

source.place: Step 1: degree-zero projective-bundle splitting with arbitrary closed support; explicit adjunction calculation

proof.text:
Put $L=A_B(a)$. Apply [lem-sp-finite-ring-compact-support-projection] with $f=q$, identity open immersion in its proper compactification, $M=A_P$ and $K=L$. The ring $A$ is finite and killed by a power of $\ell$, $q$ is proper, and the two inputs are bounded constructible. It gives the canonical isomorphism
$$\pi:(Rq_*A_P)\otimes_A^L L\xrightarrow{\sim}Rq_*Lq^*L.$$
Define $r_L=(r_0\otimes1_L)\pi^{-1}:Rq_*Lq^*L\to L$. The defining counit formula for $\pi$ in the cited node shows
$$\pi\circ(\eta_{A_B}\otimes1_L)=\eta_L.$$
Indeed the adjunct of the left side is $(\varepsilon_{A_P}\circ Lq^*\eta_{A_B})\otimes1_{Lq^*L}=1_{Lq^*L}$ by the triangle identity in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], which also characterizes the adjunct of $\eta_L$. Therefore $r_L\eta_L=(r_0\eta_{A_B})\otimes1_L=1_L$. This verifies the needed normalization under the projection formula explicitly.

source.place: Step 1: degree-zero projective-bundle splitting with arbitrary closed support; explicit adjunction calculation

proof.text:
Let $i:C\hookrightarrow B$, $i':C'=C\times_BP\hookrightarrow P$, and $M=i_*A_C$. By [lem-pur-supported-hom] the source is $\operatorname{Hom}(M,L[b])$. By [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback], the closed exchange $c:Lq^*M\xrightarrow{\sim}i'_*A_{C'}$ identifies supported pullback with $\alpha\mapsto Lq^*\alpha\circ c^{-1}$. This applies to $L$ by the etale-origin comparisons in step 2. The adjunction of [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations] consequently identifies the target supported group with
$$\operatorname{Hom}\bigl(M,(Rq_*Lq^*L)[b]\bigr).$$
Under this identification the pulled-back $\alpha$ becomes $Rq_*(Lq^*\alpha)\circ\eta_M=\eta_{L[b]}\circ\alpha$, by naturality of the adjunction unit, using the canonical shift comparisons. Define $s_q$ on this Hom group by postcomposition with $r_L[b]$. Then $s_q(q^*\alpha)=r_L[b]\eta_{L[b]}\alpha=\alpha$. All maps are additive, hence $s_q$ is a homomorphism of abelian groups. The support is arbitrary: neither this adjunction nor the cited supported-Hom comparison requires $C$ regular or smooth.

source.place: Step 1: degree-zero projective-bundle splitting with arbitrary closed support; explicit adjunction calculation

proof.text:
Apply step 5 to $(q_j,Z_{j-1})$ throughout the tower and set $s=s_{q_1}\circ\cdots\circ s_{q_s}$. The canonical module pullback comparison of [lem-pur-proetale-module-pullback-composition] is the comparison of left adjoints, so, after applying the exact pullbacks termwise as in [def-weil-pbc-proetale-operations], its adjunct identifies the unit for a composite with the composite units. Together with the formula for supported pullback in [lem-pur-supported-hom-pullback], this gives $p^*=q_s^*\cdots q_1^*$. Adjacent cancellations $s_{q_j}q_j^*=1$ now give $s p^*=1$.
Finally [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-pushforward-composition] identifies $Rp_*$ with the iterated $Rq_{j,*}$. Iterating the projective-bundle decompositions of step 3 and the projection-formula identifications of step 4 expands it into a finite sum of shifted twists indexed by tuples $(e_1,\ldots,e_s)$ with each $e_j\geq0$. The all-zero tuple gives $A_T$; every other tuple has strictly positive $\sum e_j$ and shift $-2\sum e_j$. Projecting successively onto $e_s=0,\ldots,e_1=0$ is exactly projection onto that all-zero summand, because each stage projection kills precisely its other biproduct components. The maps $s_{q_j}$ were defined from those very projections, so $s$ is the splitting prescribed in the statement. This finishes the proof for every $a,b$.

tool_uses.why: Identifies arbitrary closed-support groups with Hom from the closed constant sheaf; no purity hypothesis on the support is introduced.
Supplies finite etale coefficient lines and their pullback for every integer twist and every killing exponent; only coefficient bookkeeping is used.
Uses only its specified etale-to-pro-etale identification of the finite twist, valid for every killing exponent, to check the etale-origin hypothesis.
Carries tensor powers of the finite twist through exact comparison inverse image; no alternative geometric proof route is used.
Transfers the finite etale twist pullback comparison to ordinary pro-etale modules.
The generic proper finite-ring projection formula with identity open compactification tensors the degree-zero retraction by the Tate line.
Its normalized supported-Hom formula identifies the actual pullback on arbitrary support with the adjunction-unit map.
Identifies the composite of stage pullbacks with flag pullback using the canonical constant-coefficient module adjunctions.
Identifies Rp_* with the iterated direct images, so the successive projections are the all-zero summand of the iterated bundle decomposition.
